name: Run fair interviews and choose the candidate on evidence
why: Turns the structured hiring kit into an interview plan, scorecards, a work test and a fair comparison.

name: Hire fairly, from job post to a checked offer letter
why: Covers the full hiring run from job post to shortlist and offer, matching the hire-and-onboard workflow.

name: Problem-first job description writer
why: Builds the job description from the problem the hire must solve, the same outcomes-first method this role uses.

name: Candidate comparison table builder
why: Puts interview notes side by side on agreed criteria for the decision meeting.

name: Get a new hire to full speed in 90 days
why: A ready workflow for the first week, 90-day goals and one-on-ones that follows the onboarding plan skill.

name: New hire first week planner
why: Plans a day-by-day first week with one small real task and the people to meet.

name: Remote work policy writer
why: A worked example of a plain policy with the owner's open choices listed.

name: Handbook change desk
why: Checks each proposed handbook rule change: where it came from and what it affects.

name: Quarterly performance review keeper
why: Drafts each review from the quarter's evidence, as in the performance review skill.

name: Turn employee feedback into owned actions
why: Turns survey comments into themes and owned actions while keeping small groups private.

name: Set fair pay bands and a pay and benefits plan
why: Goes further than the pay band prompt, with market ranges and a benefits plan.

name: Let someone go fairly and tell the team well
why: Exit planning, handover and a team message, to use alongside advice from an employment lawyer.

name: Review employee data access before a change
why: Checks who can see employee data before an HR system change, supporting the records and privacy basics.
